# authwise_guard_network (Data Source)

A Guard network: a WireGuard mesh in a tenant. `cidr` is its address space inside 100.64.0.0/10, the whole of it when unset; changing it replaces the network. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_network_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
